sources.label: eaddario · GGUF task scores
notes: Scores and sizes are transcribed from the cached model card. Size table header says Size (GB) [L108]; benchmark rows are L127–134.
Shared evaluation setup: llama-perplexity with 750 tasks per test and context size 1024 tokens [L121].
Benchmark score units are not explicitly specified by the table; values are retained as published without adding a percent label.
The benchmark table spells its MMLU column MMLU-Redox [L125]; section title and dataset link identify MMLU-Redux [L120,L123].
Published uncertainties are retained in point notes without interpreting their statistical meaning. Avg Score is excluded.

sources.label: tooltd · EvalPlus
notes: EvalPlus benchmark table reports HumanEval (164 tasks) and MBPP (378 tasks) [L29–31].
Scores are pass@1, no-thinking mode, with kvcache ctk q4_0 and ctv q4_0 [L32]; fractional values are preserved on their published 0–1 scale.
File-size table header explicitly says Size (GB) [L58]. Benchmark and size rows link the same full GGUF artifacts for the five retained builds.
The GSQ-RCO-BuffedMod linked artifact is hosted in a separate tooltd repository; measurement attribution remains this model card.
Old struck-through versions, unlinked cross-publisher builds and UD3-Q3_K_XL (no matched size) are excluded.
